Name: Midnight Howl
Description:
You unleash a terrifying bestial howl, which fills the space around you with deafening noise and mental torment. Each creature (except you) within the spell's range must make a Constitution saving throw. Each target that fails takes 2d8 thunder damage and 2d8 psychic damage, and is deafened for 1 minute. Creatures deafened by this spell repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

If this spell is cast while you are in darkness or dim light, it deals an additional d8 of psychic and necrotic damage.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 4th level or higher, you may choose one of the following effects for each spell level above 3rd:

• The spell's range increases by 15 feet.
• You may exclude two other creatures from this effect.
• The spell's psychic and thunder damage each increase by 1d8.
• Creatures who fail their saving throw take half as much psychic and thunder damage, but aren't deafened.
